prompts.head_south: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: transparent RimWorld pawn head sprite. Input image 1 is the edit target; input image 2 is a SOLID COLOR REFERENCE ONLY. Perform a strictly local skin-palette replacement on the first image. Replace the existing muted brown/pink skin base with the exact pale warm ivory color shown in the second image, sRGB RGB (252,235,211), HEX #FCEBD3, copied from an existing Arknights Zima pawn texture. The face, visible ear skin, and exposed neck/nape must all use this same pale base. Skin should be flat and simple: a large uniform #FCEBD3 fill, only minimal small existing crease marks; no gradients, new blush, glints or realistic skin shading. Keep the silhouette, proportions, position, image framing and full original canvas. PRESERVE the existing eye sizes, eye spacing, iris color, pupil/highlight design, relaxed eyebrows, nose mark, mouth line, jaw and chin. This task DOES NOT enlarge or move eyes. Keep hair shape, hair color, hat shape, hat color, ribbons, bun, every non-skin part and bold dark outline as close to pixel-identical as possible. Do not change subject size or rotation. Do not redesign anything. Keep actual transparent background (alpha), no checkerboard, no text, no swatches, no labels, no other heads or shoulders. Output one edited head only. View-specific instruction: Straight front view. Lighten all facial skin and the small visible ear only; preserve the two original eyes and their horizontal spacing exactly.
